newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks dip slightly in apathetic session.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks dip slightly in apathetic session.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange edged down slightly Monday as selective profit-taking marked an otherwise sluggish post-Easter session, brokers said.
They predicted a return of investor interest Tuesday, boosted by company dividends and attractive prices.
"Today there were sales for profit-taking after Holy Week," said Flavio Campos, of Finanval brokerage. "It was a very long period and investors are cautious."
The Lima Stock Exchange's General Index .IGRA fell 0.06 percent to 1,674.07 points while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL was off 0.11 percent to close at 2,398.80 points.
Turnover reached 50.5 million soles ($19.2 million) on 1,470 trades as 31 stocks fell, 31 gained and 28 were unchanged.

Among leaders, miner Morococha fell 2.19 percent to 2.23 soles on 59,453 stocks, while brewery Compania Nacional de Cerveza dropped 2.11 percent to 1.39 sols on 249,800 shares and Minsur was off 0.39 percent to 10.39 soles on 151,323 shares.
Brokers said the market's short- and mid-term prospects were still good.
